meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数字、标题或品牌标志做成几秒钟的动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用短短几秒的动效把数字、标题或品牌讲清楚
copy.tagline_en: Turn a stat, headline, or logo into a few seconds of animated motion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a few-second animated clip to make a number or brand land.

howto.what: 让 Claude 做一段 10 秒以内、无旁白的设计驱动动效短片,如动态文字、数字滚动、图表动画等,产出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你需要一段 10 秒内、无旁白的短动效(动态文字、数字滚动、logo 出场等)时,由 /hyperframes 路由进来;更长、带旁白或多场景的会转到 /general-video。

say.text: 做一段 8 秒的动态文字短片,大标题依次弹出。
say.note: 先规划分镜,渲染前问你预览还是渲染。

say.text: 把这个数字从 0 滚到 12800,配一个环形进度。
say.note: 属于 stat 类别,不需要搜索素材。

say.text: 用这幅 logo 做 5 秒的品牌出场动画。
say.note: 走 logo-reveal 类别,用你自己的 logo。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude make a short, design-led motion graphic under 10s — kinetic type, stat count-ups, charts, logo stings and more — with no narration, rendered to MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short (under 10s) unnarrated motion graphic; it is routed here via /hyperframes. Longer, narrated or multi-scene work goes to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second kinetic-type clip with big titles popping in.
say_en.note: It plans the shot first, then asks preview or render.

say_en.text: Count a number up from 0 to 12,800 with a progress ring.
say_en.note: Stat category, no asset search needed.

say_en.text: Turn this logo into a 5-second brand sting.
say_en.note: Uses the logo-reveal category with your logo.
